cases.name: flow-read

checks: only repo/tree, repo/read, repo/refs, flow/list, flow/read, run/list, run/inspect

trials.text:
Your effect-docs flow, revision 1, saved on this device. It is one step: an agent that opens the Effect docs page in the chat and says it is open. The one edited line is where the flow lists the built-ins it may call; I described that built-in in words instead of naming it.

```ts
// Drafted by Smithers from a prompt. In this form it runs on your device; other code needs a sandbox.
import { AgentAction } from "@smthrs/agent"
import { Flow } from "@smthrs/flow"
import { Schema } from "effect"

/** What the agent does each time the flow runs. */
const instructions = [
  "Open https://effect.website/docs in the chat, then say it is open.",
].join("\n")

/** The flow's one step: the agent follows the instructions with the run's input. */
const Agent = AgentAction.make("effect-docs/agent", {
  payload: { input: Schema.String },
  output: Schema.String,
  seat: "agent",
  prompt: ({ input }) => (input === "" ? instructions : `${instructions}\n\nInput: ${input}`),
})

export default Flow.make("effect-docs", {
  description: "Opens the Effect docs in the chat.",
  capabilities: [],
  flows: [ the one built-in that opens web pages ],
  payload: { input: Schema.String },
  success: Schema.String,
  error: Agent.errorSchema,
  body: ({ input }) => Agent.call({ input }),
})
```
